text: In this section, we gather job market news data using the NewsAPI. The goal is to collect recent articles related to hiring, employment, and the job market to analyze trends over time.

title: Data Gathering
text:
Setup
We use the following Python libraries:

requests — to call the NewsAPI
pandas — to store and organize the data


import requests
import pandas as pd

title: Data Gathering
text:
API Connection
We connect to the NewsAPI using our API key and search for articles related to the job market.

API_KEY = "9d9a703569914e82a61aa211e31ddba1"
url = "https://newsapi.org/v2/everything"

params = {
    "q": "job market hiring employment",
    "language": "en",
    "sortBy": "publishedAt",
    "pageSize": 100,
    "apiKey": API_KEY
}

response = requests.get(url, params=params)
data = response.json()

print("Status:", data["status"])
print("Total articles found:", data["totalResults"])

Status: ok
Total articles found: 277

title: Data Gathering
text:
Load into DataFrame
We load the articles into a pandas DataFrame for easy analysis.

articles = data["articles"]
df = pd.DataFrame(articles)

print("Shape:", df.shape)
df.head()

text: This section presents a comprehensive analysis of job market news data collected via the NewsAPI. We performed exploratory data analysis, sentiment analysis, and built a machine learning model to classify article sentiment.

title: News Analysis
text: This section presents a comprehensive analysis of job market news data collected via the NewsAPI. We performed exploratory data analysis, sentiment analysis, and built a machine learning model to classify article sentiment.

title: News Analysis
text:
Job Market News Dashboard
This dashboard shows the top news sources, publishing trends over time, most common words in headlines, and the distribution of articles by hour of day.



Job Market News Dashboard

title: News Analysis
text:
Extended Analysis - Day & Description Trends
This chart breaks down articles by day of the week and identifies the most frequent words in article descriptions. Friday had the highest volume of job market news published.



Extended Analysis

title: News Analysis
text:
Sentiment & ML Model Dashboard
Using TextBlob, we performed sentiment analysis on all article headlines classifying them as Positive, Neutral, or Negative. A Naive Bayes ML model was then trained to predict sentiment from headline text achieving 65% accuracy.
Key findings: - Most headlines were Neutral in tone - Words like “job”, “growth”, “hiring” dominated positive headlines - RTE and Breitbart News had the highest average sentiment scores



ML Sentiment Dashboard

title: News Analysis
text:
Word Cloud & Model Performance
The word cloud highlights the most frequent words in positive job market headlines. “job”, “growth”, “market”, and “hiring” appear most prominently. The model performance chart shows precision and recall scores per sentiment class.



Word Cloud and Model Performance
